summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K containing its 1Q26 performance report. The filing is a routine quarterly update covering consolidated results, capex, liquidity, and debt metrics for the Brazilian state-controlled oil and gas company. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or corporate action is announced. The document includes forward-looking statements and non-IFRS financial indicators but does not describe any special situation event. As a non-US foreign private issuer filing an earnings release under cover of Form 6-K, this is an ordinary periodic report with no special-situations trigger.
